title: GOP Rep. Tony Gonzales heads to a runoff in Texas amid a new ethics probe in the House
summary: Texas Republican Rep. Tony Gonzales has faced increasing pressure from his party to resign or drop out of his race after allegations of an affair with a staffer.
contentText:
Texas Republican Rep. Tony Gonzales has faced increasing pressure from his party to resign or drop out of his race after allegations of an affair with a staffer.
